fallback: 250ms deadline; same-scope approved cache or empty injection
concurrency: host session IDs scoped by adapter and persona; no mutable latent sharing
context_signals: previous-turn tool names and error count (post_tool_call; never arguments or results), platform channel, declared context (OPENAPE_CONTEXT); user message only with OPENAPE_CONTEXT_TEXT=local, classified locally and never sent
subagents: opt out: sessions announced by subagent_start receive no injection
agent_tools: persona_feedback (ctx.register_tool, toolset openape; active mode only)
unverified: derived turn context against a real Hermes run (post_tool_call signals)
